purpose: Define the objective evidence Worldshepherd must show before presenting itself as the preferred selection for recurring defense and federal decision-support opportunities.
claims_boundary: This matrix does not claim Worldshepherd is superior to named competitors, selected by government, certified for controlled environments, or production-proven at required scales. It defines evidence needed to make a defensible selection case.

market_reference_classes.Palantir: decision-centric ontology, human/AI workflows, deployment and operational lineage
market_reference_classes.Scale_Donovan: mission-tailored AI agents, traceability, model agnosticism, classified/air-gapped deployment and T&E
market_reference_classes.Anduril_Lattice: open edge data mesh, C2, autonomy integration and production operational deployment
market_reference_classes.C3_AI: defense AI applications, predictive readiness, multi-source decision support and accredited environments

selection_dimensions.government_signal: Army requires structured, auditable, signer-ready Decision Packages with reproducible workflows, explicit assumptions, risks, bias checks and human control.
selection_dimensions.worldshepherd_position: SARA + PRIME + ECHO + PRE architecture is directionally aligned and is now exercised inside the green selection-core baseline.

selection_dimensions.government_signal: DIU requires transparent reasoning, confidence scoring and data provenance; NAVWAR calls auditable history critical for operator trust.
selection_dimensions.worldshepherd_position: ECHO provenance, PRE qualification bundles and SARA audit primitives have reproducible internal evidence; the qualification compiler reported no bundle failures in the green selection baseline.
proof_to_win: source-to-decision lineage in one evaluator-facing scenario

selection_dimensions.government_signal: Army and NAVWAR explicitly preserve human control/operator approval; DIU supports analyst/human-on-loop workflows.
selection_dimensions.worldshepherd_position: PRIME policy/authorization controls are included in the passing selection-core test surface.
proof_to_win: deny-by-default action policy in evaluator demo

selection_dimensions.government_signal: NAVWAR favors API-first loose coupling and containerization; DIU requires modular cloud-native/containerized architecture and open standards.
selection_dimensions.worldshepherd_position: Containerized verified-local SARA architecture, mission-pack adapters and versioned interface tests provide internal evidence; further evaluator-facing API packaging remains needed.

selection_dimensions.government_signal: Multiple opportunities require degraded-state operation, replay, historical state, resilient operations or edge deployment.
selection_dimensions.worldshepherd_position: DDIL tests and operational-resilience CI now provide reproducible internal evidence. In run 34798178408, a controlled runtime-loss drill restored readiness/state/build identity with measured recovery of 2.0 seconds on the CI host.
proof_to_win: network partition test in evaluator scenario
repeat recovery testing across representative failure modes

selection_dimensions.government_signal: DIU Space Threat sets a 5-second latency threshold, 2-second objective, nominal 20-30 MB/min and burst handling up to about 5 GB/min.
selection_dimensions.worldshepherd_position: Bounded synthetic in-process fusion performance is now measured. On CI commit f8d51e88af6cd82e9c649ad4095e89cb5ded4340, 10,000 synthetic observations (~1.10 MB serialized input) produced deterministic output at 36.97 ms p95, equivalent to about 1,788 MB/min for that function-only workload. This excludes network, API, persistence, imagery/video/radar decoding, inference, storage/retrieval, security-domain controls and UI, so it is not end-to-end DIU performance evidence.
proof_to_win: persistent-store write/read and historical retrieval benchmark
eventual representative end-to-end evaluation against opportunity-specific targets

selection_dimensions.government_signal: DIU requires NIST SP 800-171 and classified/CUI capabilities; NAVWAR projects CMMC Level 2 Self and current Q&A states all NP004 Phase-I data/activity is CUI; larger incumbents publicly claim accredited/classified deployments.
selection_dimensions.worldshepherd_position: Compliance readiness controls and a PUBLIC-ONLY boundary exist; certification/authorization and a controlled production enclave are not claimed.
proof_to_win: incident response and continuous monitoring evidence

selection_dimensions.government_signal: Army Agentic AI Phase II expects a commercial open-source platform usable by DoW and commercial enterprises.
selection_dimensions.worldshepherd_position: Repository is public, but no LICENSE file was detected in the branch root. Public source visibility does not establish open-source licensing.

selection_dimensions.government_signal: DIU differentiators include mission-critical support, 24/7 availability and resilient sustainment; incumbents have public operational deployments.
selection_dimensions.worldshepherd_position: Internal resilience evidence exists, but no equivalent independent operational customer/reference is currently claimed.

preferred_choice_gate.minimum_condition: Worldshepherd may be presented internally as PREFERRED_CHOICE_READY only when D1-D5 are evidenced by reproducible evaluator-facing demos, D6 has opportunity-specific end-to-end benchmark evidence where applicable, D7 passes the target contract's mandatory compliance gates, D8 is resolved for opportunities requiring open-source licensing, and at least one external reference or partner validation closes D9.
preferred_choice_gate.reason: Worldshepherd now has green reproducible selection-core evidence, qualification bundles, a controlled resilience drill, and bounded synthetic performance evidence. Remaining blockers are end-to-end operational scale, controlled-environment/compliance evidence, licensing where required, and independent external validation.

next_critical_artifact: Worldshepherd Evaluator Demonstration Pack v1: containerized synthetic scenario plus reproducibility instructions, requirements-to-evidence crosswalk, exact-commit evidence bundle, bounded performance report, known-negative-evidence register, and independent-review checklist.
